Silver-lining flatworm
Pseudoceros cf. prudhoeiFamily Pseudocerotidae
updated Feb 2020

Where seen? This black flatworm like a storm cloud with a silver lining is sometimes seen on reefs in our Southern shores.

Features: 5-8cm long. Body black with inner broad white margin and a yellow rim.
